title: The NEW MSFS Marketplace activities are here... worth It?
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases from Perfect Flight so you can skip the menu guessing and know exactly where to point your nose cone next.

We divide the breakdown into two major categories:
✈️ Commercial Routings & Elite Operations: A deep dive into the massive structural schedules for virtual airline captains and tactical flyers. We break down the 12-leg Air Canada Summer 2026 schedule featuring high-fidelity telemetry event tracking across Canada's most challenging airfields, along with the precise system cross-compatibilities for the Inibuilds A320 Neo V2 across simulator versions. Additionally, we evaluate the tactical requirements for the Advanced Jet Carrier Landings package, forcing pilots to thread the needle across multiple carrier classes. Note: This requires the Super Carrier Pro add-on by Miltech Simulations to function!
🌍 Scenic Wilderness & VFR Excursions: A close look at high-fidelity visual flight profiles designed to pull back the throttle and test your stick-and-rudder fundamentals. We examine the Advanced VFR England circuit flown inside the Beechcraft Bonanza G36, utilizing dedicated interactive companion infrastructure to map out visual routes from the Scottish border down to the Cornish coast. Finally, we review the Blackpool Adventures Master Collection bundle, providing structured, guided evaluations across the Pacific Northwest, Northern Rockies, and the American West.

Whether you choose to command a multi-leg commercial jetliner rotation with Air Canada, put your precision handling to the ultimate test on a grueling carrier deck recovery, or pull back the throttle to explore historic back-country sceneries, Perfect Flight has delivered a massive structural playground for flight simulator enthusiasts this week.

Let me know in the comments: are you choosing the heavy commercial airliners or testing the carrier traps first? Smash the like button, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
